title: Practice automated-review policy
description: Author-defined evidence Hephaestus needs before it may review work against one practice revision.

sourceContractVersion.title: Source contract version
sourceContractVersion.description: Exact version that defines the available evidence sources and their states.

evidenceProfile.title: Evidence profile
evidenceProfile.description: Set of evidence sources allowed for this type of reviewed work.

automatedReview.title: Automated review
automatedReview.description: How Hephaestus may review the practice. This author declaration does not describe or validate review by a developer, peer, or human mentor.

mode.title: Review mode
mode.description: Implementation Hephaestus uses for automated review.

evidenceSufficiency.title: Evidence sufficiency
evidenceSufficiency.description: Whether meeting every declared requirement is enough for Hephaestus to review the work.

requiredEvidence.title: Required evidence
requiredEvidence.description: Every source in this list must meet its quality requirements before automated review may start.

optionalContext.title: Optional context
optionalContext.description: Sources that may add context but never block automated review when absent.

whenEvidenceIsInsufficient.title: Insufficient evidence action
whenEvidenceIsInsufficient.description: Conservative action when a required source is unavailable, incomplete, or not current.

knownLimitations.title: Known limitations
knownLimitations.description: Claims this evidence cannot support even when every requirement is met.

requirement.title: Required evidence source

sourceKind.title: Source kind
sourceKind.description: Stable source identifier from the selected source contract.

completeness.title: Completeness requirement
completeness.description: Minimum completeness the source must establish.

content.title: Content requirement
content.description: Whether a valid but empty capture is enough to judge. Absent means NO_REQUIREMENT.

requirement.description: Completeness, freshness, and content requirements for one blocking evidence source.

optionalContextSource.title: Optional context source
optionalContextSource.description: A source that may add context but never blocks automated review when absent.

sourceKind.title: Source kind
sourceKind.description: Stable source identifier from the selected source contract.

limitation.title: Known limitation

description.title: Limitation description
description.description: Plain-language explanation of the unsupported claim.

limitation.description: A claim the selected evidence cannot support even when every requirement passes.
